quota_intro: Manage devices, server playback and file transfers. Local listening does not use a server playback slot.
quota_draining: Usage includes work that is still stopping. Refresh this page to see current counts.
quota_defaults_intro: These values apply where an account has no individual limit.
quota_inheritance: Leave a field empty to inherit its default. Clear all three fields to reset this account to the defaults.
quota_lowering: Lowering a limit preserves current work and devices. New work waits until usage falls below the limit.
quota_budget_intro: All accounts share these limits. Values cannot exceed this server's measured capacity.
quota_measure_first: The operator must record a capacity measurement before these limits can be configured.
quota_accounts_scope: Your account and accounts connected through your invitations.
quota_error_values: Check the values: limits must be positive whole numbers. Reload the form before trying again.
quota_error_authority: Your current access does not permit this change. Sign in again or return to an available account.
quota_error_unavailable: Resource settings are temporarily unavailable or server capacity has not been configured. Try again later.
quota_error_conflict: The settings changed, this request conflicts, or a value exceeds measured capacity. Reload the current settings before saving again.
passkey_login_intro: Sign in with a passkey. Confirm using your device fingerprint or PIN.
passkey_intro: Add a key on this laptop or A55 for your next sign-in. Admin access also requires device admission on the private network.
passkey_label: Key name, such as Laptop or A55
passkey_add: Add a key on this device
passkey_empty: No keys yet. Add your first key on this device.
passkey_confirm_remove: Revoke key and end its sessions
passkey_revoke_consequence: This key will no longer permit sign-in. All browser sessions opened with it will end. If this session uses the key, you will need to sign in again using another method.
passkey_error: Sign-in or key registration did not complete. Reload the page and retry. If a response was lost, a saved key can be used for a fresh sign-in.
passkey_action_error: The result could not be confirmed. Reload the page to check your keys or sign in again.
passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Open this page over HTTPS in a supported browser or use emergency sign-in.
next_action_title: What would you like to do?
accounts_section_intro: Connect devices and manage their access to your account.
music_section_intro: Follow imports, downloads and music processing jobs.
server_section_intro: Check storage, server health, backups and the activity log.
development_warning: Development mode: browser authentication is limited to this loopback computer.
login_intro: Enter the short-lived browser invitation shown by the local administrative CLI.
secret_warning: Keep this one-time value private. It is never displayed again.
dashboard_intro: Bounded health and capability status for this personal server.
empty_body: No authorized records match this view.
unavailable_body: Use the local administrative CLI or retry when the required component is healthy.
auth_required_body: Create a new browser invitation with the local administrative CLI.
terminal_error_title: The request could not be completed
name: Name
confirm_revoke: Revoke access? This immediately ends the selected target's server access.
confirm_cancel: Cancel this invitation? It cannot be used afterward.
target_all_browser_sessions: All browser sessions for this account
logout_all_consequence: Sign out every browser session for this account, including this one?
cli_only: Available from the local administrative CLI only
no_secret_notice: Enrollment secrets are never displayed in this Web interface.
devices_intro: Authorized Android devices for this account.
sessions_intro: Active and terminal Android and browser sessions.
invitations_intro: Metadata only; enrollment bearer values are never shown here.
vault_intro: Aggregate integrity and replica health without storage paths.
jobs_intro: Bounded background work owned by this account.
live_refresh_active: Live updates are active. This page refreshes every 10 seconds.
job_statistics_scope: Statistics cover the bounded set of jobs shown on this page.
recent_jobs_intro: Newest work first. Progress comes from durable worker checkpoints.
progress_unavailable: Progress is not available for this job yet
imports_intro: Bounded import status without source files or paths.
review_intro: Ambiguous import evidence that requires an explicit decision.
recovery_intro: Verified recovery evidence when an authoritative record exists.
backup_intro: Choose an approved storage agent, cap each generation, and monitor the current backup without exposing filesystem paths.
backup_policy_intro: Only storage agents registered by the operator can be selected. Paths are never accepted from the browser.
backup_schedule_notice: Day and hour are used only in automatic mode. The manual backup button remains available in both modes.
backup_hard_limit_notice: The agent raises an alert at the warning threshold and stops before writing beyond the hard limit.
backup_agent_notice: Requesting a backup does not grant the web process storage or Docker privileges. The approved out-of-process agent claims and runs the request.
backup_requested: Backup requested. The approved agent can now claim it.
backup_waiting_for_agent: Waiting for the approved backup agent.
backup_limit_alert: Backup storage is approaching its configured generation limit. Free capacity or select another approved destination.
backup_error_forbidden: Only an owner can manage server backups.
backup_error_backup_control_unavailable: Backup control state is unavailable or invalid.
backup_error_backup_size_invalid: Enter a supported maximum backup size.
backup_error_backup_warning_invalid: The warning threshold must be between 50 and 99 percent.
backup_error_backup_schedule_invalid: Choose manual mode or a valid automatic weekday and hour.
backup_error_backup_policy_stale: The backup policy changed. Reload the page and try again.
backup_error_backup_policy_missing: Save a backup policy before requesting a backup.
backup_error_backup_already_active: A backup is already requested or running.
diagnostics_intro: Redacted operational facts suitable for support.
audit_intro: Bounded administrative actions and safe outcomes.
discovery_intro: Search Jamendo metadata and explicitly add an artist-authorized track through the verified Vault pipeline.
discovery_staging_notice: Search reads metadata only. Add to Vault queues a durable job; the track appears as ready only after rights recheck, identity materialization and verified Vault ingest.
discovery_staged: The selected file and attribution evidence were staged on the server.
discovery_staged_duplicate: This exact operation was already staged; the existing receipt was returned.
discovery_queued: The selected track was queued for verified Vault acquisition.
discovery_queue_replayed: This exact Add request was already accepted; its durable result was returned.
collection_import_intro: Use artist<TAB>title<TAB>album or artist - title. The file is bounded to 2 MiB and 10,000 rows.
collection_imported: The TXT collection was imported. Select artists before any provider download starts.
collection_import_replayed: This exact TXT collection already exists; its previous import was returned.
collection_expand_intro: Artists are ordered by the number of their tracks in this collection. Select at most 20.
bulk_resolution_intro: Imported names are never treated as provider identity. Only one exact normalized Jamendo match is eligible.
bulk_track_preview_intro: The top half of each matched artist catalog is shown within the 25-per-artist and 200-total caps. Planned tracks:
bulk_start_confirmation: This explicit action queues only the eligible previewed tracks. Each track is checked again and becomes available only after verified Vault ingest.
bulk_started: Expansion queued. Track failures are isolated and visible in the durable operation state.
bulk_start_replayed: This exact expansion request was already accepted; its durable result was returned.
discovery_operation_not_found: The discovery operation was not found.
component_api_detail: The administrative API answered this authenticated request.
component_postgresql_detail: Authoritative metadata is reachable and queryable.
component_worker_detail: Idle worker liveness is not persisted; verify it with the local CLI.
component_vault_detail: Aggregate integrity and replica evidence only; storage paths stay hidden.
footer_privacy: Private administrative surface. No analytics or third-party assets.
connection_requests_intro: Paste the exact one-time review locator from the Android device.
connection_requests_private_notice: The locator is submitted only in this form. It is never put in a URL or displayed after review starts.
connection_request_review_intro: Compare the 3 by 4 string with the Android device before choosing a consequence.
comparison_string_intro: All three four-digit groups must match exactly.
connection_request_decision_intro: Each action is scoped to your signed-in account only.
approve_once_consequence: Allow this exact key to complete one enrollment. It does not create ongoing trust.
trust_device_consequence: Allow this exact key to complete enrollment and retain trust after the successful enrollment.
reject_request_consequence: Reject this request. The device cannot enroll from this request.
block_device_consequence: Reject this request and block this exact key from future admission. Existing access is unchanged.
trusted_devices_intro: Exact-key trust and access controls for this signed-in account.
remove_trust_consequence: Remove future trust only. Existing device sessions remain active.
block_future_admission_consequence: Block this key from future admission only. Existing sessions remain active.
unblock_future_admission_consequence: Permit future admission for this key. It does not restore trust or access.
revoke_access_consequence: End existing device/session access. It does not remove trust.
revoke_and_remove_consequence: Explicitly end existing access and remove future trust.
